# Contributing and feedback

**[Magyar](CONTRIBUTING.md)** | **[English](CONTRIBUTING.en.md)**

> Thank you for considering contributing to **Neptun Plus**.

## Contributing

It is recommended to have at least basic knowledge of `React` and `TypeScript` before contributing to the project.

The project follows the **[SemVer](https://semver.org)** versioning standard. The `universities.json` file uses its own version number in the following format:

- `u#` → for example: `v1.2.3-u4`

## Feedback

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Before submitting any feedback, please check whether the issue or suggestion already exists.

### Bug reports

If you want to report a bug, please include the following:

- a clear description of the problem
- the steps to reproduce the issue
- the expected vs. actual behavior
- the engine and browser used (for example: Gecko, Firefox)
- the appropriate labels, so development and filtering are easier

### Suggestions

If you want to suggest a new feature or idea, please make sure the suggestion includes:

- a clear description of the problem or need
- a description of the proposed solution, whether technical or non-technical
- a brief explanation of why it would be useful
- examples or use cases, if available

### Resources

- [Development backlog](https://github.com/users/Py-xel/projects/4): The work we are currently doing.
